from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import rdMolDescriptors
s='CCCCCC(C)NC(=O)C=CC1=CC(OC)=C(OC)C(OC)=C1'

print('valid:', m is not None)
print('formula:', rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m) if m else None)
